<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス：北の峠　第４マーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分のＡＴ－ＡＴはここに移動する際フォースを消費しない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-North-Ridge-4th-Marker-Dark-PSA-152940018.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: North Ridge, 4th Marker.

'''Dark Side:'''
Your AT-ATs do not spend Force when moving here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
